body: Yeah, states get capitalized, but I don't see any reason to capitalize these descriptions.
For precisely this reason. I think WebKit even implements it as a shadow root.

So I think you are talking about some other concept then, not defined in specs. Maybe it is called "user agent shadow root". But it is something that can be applied to details, and does not appear as a `shadowRoot` property, and so on.

I don't think we should include a reference to such an undefined concept in here.
